_comment: MAGI System custom agent configuration. Copy to magi.config.json and customize. The default council (MELCHIOR/BALTHASAR/CASPAR) needs NO config — it uses the plugin-native agents in plugins/magi/agents/. Use this only to define a custom council. Odd N >= 3 voting agents required. Custom agent files should contain a $ARGUMENTS placeholder for topic injection.

agents.name: THREAT-MODEL
agents.persona: Security threat analyst — attack surfaces, abuse cases, data exposure

agents.name: COMPLIANCE
agents.persona: Regulatory specialist — licensing, privacy, audit requirements

agents.name: ARCHITECTURE
agents.persona: System architect — boundaries, coupling, evolution paths
